faq.q: Is Ladner Rural the same search as Ladner farms or East Delta?
faq.a: No — on this page, Ladner Rural is its own Paragon sub-area and its whole 11-listing feed is labelled Ladner Rural only, with no East Delta or Westham Island cards; the separate ladner-farms page is the one whose feed spans sub-areas.

faq.q: Why are there float homes on a "Homes & Acreages" page?
faq.a: Because they sit inside the same sub-area: six of the cards read for this file are float homes on West River Road, several naming the Canoe Pass community and boat slips in their listing texts, alongside inland acreage and farm listings on 34B Avenue and 64 Street.

faq.q: How big can a house be on ALR land in Ladner Rural?
faq.a: Delta's A1 zone permits one farm house per lot at a maximum total floor area of 500 m², on a farm home plate of at most 3,600 m² (5,000 m² where an additional farm house is also on the plate).

faq.q: Can a Ladner Rural farm have a second dwelling?
faq.a: Yes, within limits: the A1 zone permits one accessory farm dwelling unit per lot — 90 m² or less on lots of 40 ha or smaller, 186 m² or less on larger lots — on the same farm home plate as the farm house; more than one needs Agricultural Land Commission approval, and an additional farm house needs an agrologist's necessity report plus written ALC approval.
